config_name: XPS 13 — Core Ultra 7 355, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB SSD, 13.4" 2.5K touch 120Hz (Storm or Sky)

specs.cpu: Intel Core Ultra 7 355 (Series 3 Panther Lake, 8-core, up to 4.7 GHz)

battery.notes: Panther Lake efficiency cores help; ~10-13h light mixed use estimated from XPS 14 (2026) class results.

price.notes: VERIFIED dell.ca 2026-11-24: CAD $1,649.99 (est. value $2,199.99, save $550). Both Storm and Sky colors.

offers.name: Dell XPS 13.4" Laptop - Graphite (Intel Core Ultra 7 - Series 2/16GB RAM/512GB SSD)

reviews.quote: It's great to see Dell bring back the XPS and do so with such style.

praises: Core Ultra 7 355 makes this a Copilot+ PC with a real NPU — the sweet spot CPU for the chassis
16GB/512GB is the minimum sensible config and it's $550 off during Black Friday
1 kg weight with a 120Hz 2.5K touch display — nothing else at this weight class
Runs cool and quiet; Panther Lake sips power in the thin XPS 13 chassis
"beautiful display" is the most repeated phrase in dell.ca owner reviews
complaints: RAM and SSD both soldered — buying 16GB means living with 16GB forever
No fingerprint reader on the 2026 XPS line (CNET con on XPS 14, same platform)
Two USB-C ports only; users report needing a dock for anything beyond a mouse
Zero-lattice keyboard takes adjustment; some owners report key-feel complaints (Dell review summary)
Price jumps steeply for the 32GB/1TB tier (~$2,300), making this mid tier the value center

design_philosophy: The 2026 XPS 13 is Dell's statement that premium means sub-1 kg: CNC aluminum, Gorilla Glass, and a display that Dell claims gives up to 17 hours of video. The Ultra 7 355 tier adds the Copilot+ NPU and modern Arc-class iGPU without the RAM ceiling of the base Core 5.
rating_notes: Inferred from CNET XPS 14 (2026) 8.1 anchor + dell.ca specs: Ultra 7 355 same CPU as reviewed XPS 14 base tier → productivity +1 vs Core 5 entry, ai_ml +2 (Copilot+ NPU). Portability unchanged at 1.0 kg.
